page_title: POR 0-1 SPA | Portugal v Spain 06/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+9' Joao Neves (Portugal) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ferran Torres (Spain) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Borja Iglesias (Spain) comes onto the pitch so that Mikel Oyarzabal can be given a rest.
90+6' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
90+4' Renato Veiga (Portugal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

90+1' 0 - 1 Mikel Merino (Spain) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Ferran Torres, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Dani Olmo as he is replaced by Mikel Merino (Spain).
85' The game has come to an end for Pedri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fabian Ruiz (Spain).
83' Roberto Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bernardo Silva (Portugal) replacing Vitinha.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Francisco Conceicao (Portugal) coming on for Pedro Neto.
80' Rodri (Spain) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
79' Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Ferran Torres (Spain) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
79' Lamine Yamal (Spain) swings in a cross from the corner, but Diogo Costa reads it well and gathers the ball.
78' That's unlucky! Dani Olmo (Spain) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Spain have a corner.
76' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Bruno Fernandes (Portugal), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.

76' Vitinha (Portugal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Baena trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ferran Torres (Spain).
73' Alex Baena (Spain) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
73' Lamine Yamal (Spain) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is comfortably saved by Diogo Costa. Spain earn a corner.
72' Nelson Semedo (Portugal) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. That's a free kick to Spain.
71' Roberto Martinez has decided to substitute Joao Cancelo and he is replaced by Diogo Dalot (Portugal).
71' Substitution. Joao Felix makes his way off the pitch and Rafael Leao (Portugal) comes on as his replacement.
68' A cooling break is underway.
65' Alex Baena (Spain) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.
63' Poor challenge! Pedri (Spain) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
62' Diogo Costa leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alex Baena (Spain).

62' Lamine Yamal (Spain) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Spain manage to earn a corner.
61' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Baena (Spain), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
61' Pedri (Spain) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Spain force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' A clumsy foul by Lamine Yamal (Spain) and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
59' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Unai Simon and he makes a comfortable save.
58' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
56' Problems for Roberto Martinez as Nuno Mendes (Portugal) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Nelson Semedo replaces him.
54' Nuno Mendes (Portugal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
50' Foul! Lamine Yamal (Spain) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
49' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
48' Dani Olmo (Spain) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Joao Felix (Portugal) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
45+3' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle as Pau Cubarsi (Spain) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
45+2' Ruben Dias (Portugal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Spain have a free kick.
45+2' Flag goes up against Lamine Yamal (Spain) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' The ball rebounds to Rodri (Spain) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
41' Nuno Mendes (Portugal) gets into a promising shooting position on the edge of the box after a nice pass, but his effort is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders.
41' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Nuno Mendes (Portugal).
40' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Portugal will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Pedro Porro (Spain) jumps into a tackle and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.

37' Unai Simon pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
37' Joao Felix (Portugal) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
35' Lamine Yamal (Spain) tackles a bit over-zealously and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
34' Dani Olmo (Spain) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
31' Dangerous play by Aymeric Laporte (Spain). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Dani Olmo (Spain) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header well wide of the left post! A typical school boy error!
30' Alex Baena (Spain) takes a short corner kick.
30' Pedro Porro (Spain) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Pedro Neto (Portugal) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
28' Ball possession – 44:56.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

23' A big rebound falls at the feet of Pedro Porro (Spain). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.
23' Alex Baena (Spain) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
22' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Spain are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
21' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
19' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alex Baena (Spain) brought his opponent down.
17' Alex Baena (Spain) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

16' Alex Baena (Spain) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Diogo Costa gets a hand to it and keeps it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Spain.
16' Lamine Yamal (Spain) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Diogo Costa is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
14' Alex Baena (Spain) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
12' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nuno Mendes (Portugal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

12' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Unai Simon is alert and denies him. The ball is out of play. Portugal win a corner kick.
11' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Joao Felix (Portugal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
9' Joao Felix (Portugal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Portugal.
8' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
7' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
6' Some great controlled play and passing from Spain. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

3' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Diogo Costa was ready and made a save.
2' The referee blows his whistle as Lamine Yamal (Spain) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
Spain will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will supervise the game today.
